title: Squares and triangles of a Roman mosaic, Pompeii
subtitle: Roman mosaic, Pompeii

given.O: The centre of a whole square.

construction.note: The finished design was read from Brian Wichmann’s CM006A drawing. The frame is turned by 45° so OA follows a mirror line and is half a square diagonal. The square and its compass transfers give every corner exactly. The drawing gives no steps; we devised the construction.
construction.changes: The plain boundaries are retained. The palette is illustrative. This is a Roman mosaic, not an Islamic building attribution. No photograph was checked. The compass steps, their order and the named points are ours.

credits.source: Tiling Search, data6/CM006A: Roman mosaic, Pompeii
credits.creator: Brian Wichmann
credits.note: Read from his finished drawing, not construction instructions. Cahier and Martin, 376 Decorative Allover Patterns from Historic Tilework and Textiles, page 6, top left; Balmelle et al., Le décor géométrique de la mosaïque romaine, plate 118(d), Pompeii; Dawes and Wichmann, A New Class of Tilings with Two Prototiles (Visual Mathematics 3(4), 2001), PP class 27, IH class 65.

steps.text: Draw a horizontal straight line through O and A. Draw a circle with centre O through A.

Draw a vertical line through O. The two lines cross the circle at A, B, C and D. Draw a vertical line through each of A and B. Draw a horizontal line through each of C and D. They cross at K1, K2, K3 and K4. Draw a straight line through O and K1.
steps.textWithoutHelpers: Draw a vertical line through O. The two lines cross the circle at A, B, C and D. Draw a vertical line through A. Draw a horizontal line through each of C and D. The lines through A and C cross at K1. Draw a straight line through O and K1.

steps.text: Draw a straight line through A and C. Turn it round O by 90°, three times. These lines are the sides of the square at O.
Draw a circle with centre A through O. It crosses the horizontal line through O again at E, right of A. Draw a circle with centre O through E. It crosses the vertical line through O at F, above O.
Draw a vertical line through E. Draw a horizontal line through F. Turn both lines round O by 180°. They cross at N1, N2, N3 and N4.
Draw a circle with centre E and opening OA. It crosses the horizontal line through O at G, right of E. Draw a line through G at 90° to the line from O to K1. Turn it round O by 90°, three times.
Join N1, N2, N3 and N4 to mark the tile that repeats.

ink.text: Ink the lines picked out in orange.

pattern.text: Put copies of the square tile side by side.
